title: Look something up from the chat
summary: A tool: type its word and a name, and get the row of your table that matches, as a card.
description: A tool for your team, used from the chat on the web, the phone app, WhatsApp, Telegram and Slack. Type its word and at least two letters of what you are looking for ("/find-customer Ada") and it finds the first row of your table whose column matches, and answers with a card: that row's name and two more of its columns. It only reads, so it answers at once, with what it understood. Choose the word it is called by when you install it; if that word is taken, it gets the next free one (find-customer-2) and says so.

params.name: command
params.title: Its word
params.description: What people type to use it, after /. Letters, numbers and dashes.

params.name: roles
params.title: Who can use it
params.description: The roles whose people may use it from the chat; owners always may. It reads your table, so keep it to those who may see it.

params.name: match_column
params.title: Found by
params.description: The column it matches the words against, such as name.

params.name: first_column
params.title: Shows first
params.description: A column it shows on the card.

params.name: second_column
params.title: Shows next
params.description: Another column it shows on the card.

definition.name: Look up
definition.description: Finds a row of a table by a word and shows it as a card.

outputs.name: title
outputs.title: Name
outputs.description: The row's name, or what was not found
